payouts.confirmBody:
Stripe (our payment processor) will ask for:
• Your legal date of birth
• Last 4 digits of your SIN
• A Canadian bank account

This is required by financial regulations and takes about 2 minutes.
payouts.incompleteBody: Stripe requires your full address. Add: {{missing}}.
payouts.progressBody: Tap to finish onboarding with Stripe.
payouts.unsupportedCountryBody: Payouts are available for providers in {{supported}} only. Your current country is {{country}}. Update your address to continue.

addressEdit.invalidCountryBody: Only CA and US are supported right now.

payoutsV2.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
payoutsV2.fillAllBody: Please fill in every field before continuing.
payoutsV2.personalInfoSubtitle: Stripe needs your legal identity to send you payouts. We pre-filled what we already know.
payoutsV2.taxSubtitle: Required by financial regulations. Stripe stores it encrypted and never echoes it back.
payoutsV2.taxHelp: 9 digits. Dashes and spaces are stripped automatically.
payoutsV2.bankSubtitle: Payouts will land in this account.
payoutsV2.bankCaHelp: Find your transit and institution numbers on a void cheque or in your online banking.
payoutsV2.bankUsHelp: Find your 9-digit routing number on a check or in your online banking.
payoutsV2.bankCaInvalidBody: Transit must be 5 digits and institution must be 3 digits.
payoutsV2.bankUsInvalidBody: Routing number must be exactly 9 digits.
payoutsV2.bankAccountInvalidBody: Account number must contain at least 4 digits.
payoutsV2.bankHolderInvalidBody: Please enter the account holder's full name.
payoutsV2.idDocSubtitle: Take a photo of a government-issued ID and a selfie so Stripe can confirm your identity.
payoutsV2.idDocStep1: 1. A government-issued ID (driver's licence, passport, ID card)
payoutsV2.idDocStep3: 3. A few minutes — the camera will guide you
payoutsV2.idDocHostedNote: Stripe will guide you through ID capture and selfie. You'll return here when done.
payoutsV2.idDocCanceled: Verification cancelled. Tap try again to retry.
payoutsV2.idDocSdkNote: The native camera UI will be enabled in the next build. Tap skip to continue the rest of the setup.
payoutsV2.tosSubtitle: Last step. Read and accept Stripe's terms to activate payouts.
payoutsV2.tosBody: By accepting, you agree to Stripe's Connected Account Agreement (which incorporates the Stripe Services Agreement) and confirm that the information you provided is accurate. Your IP and device are recorded as proof of acceptance.
payoutsV2.tosCheckLabel: I have read and accept Stripe's terms.
payoutsV2.tosNotAcceptedBody: You must check the box to continue.
